description: One page of an account's most recent validated transactions, newest first. When to use: To check what an account did recently (payments sent or received, offers, trust line changes) and whether each transaction succeeded. Prefer another tool: For balances and trust lines, use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/summary` or `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/lines`; for full archival history, use a full-history node or indexer: history depth depends on the serving node and older pages may be slower. Example: xrpl_account_transactions {"address":"rvYAfWj5gh67oV6fW32ZzP3Aw4Eubs59B"}

address.description: Valid classic XRPL account address (r..., checksum verified)

limit.description: Transactions per page: an integer from 1 to 50 (default 20)

marker.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `marker`, for the same address

name: xrpl_account_transactions

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

marker.description: Opaque cursor for the next (older) page (send as `marker`); null on the last page

transactions.description: Validated transactions, newest first; entries without a ledger index last, in their upstream order

balance_changes.description: The address's signed net balance changes in this transaction: XRP first, then the other assets sorted by spelling; zero changes omitted; the XRP change of an outgoing transaction includes the fee

asset.description: `XRP`, `CODE.counterparty` for a trust line (code as on the ledger) or a 48-hex MPT issuance id

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

value.description: Signed net change in units of `asset`; for an MPT, the display amount (`value_atomic` / 10^`AssetScale`, exact) when the route read the issuance's `AssetScale`, else null

value_atomic.description: MPT only: the signed net change in whole base units; absent for XRP and issued currencies

close_time.description: Ledger close time, ISO-8601 UTC; null when the ledger entry carries none

counterparty.description: The other account, when the transaction names one

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

value.description: Decimal string in units of `asset`; for an MPT, the display amount (`value_atomic` / 10^`AssetScale`, exact) when the route read the issuance's `AssetScale`, else null

value_atomic.description: MPT only: the exact amount in whole base units; absent for XRP and issued currencies

delivered.description: Delivered amount, when the transaction reports one

delivered_unavailable.description: True only when the ledger reports the delivered amount as `unavailable`

direction.description: `out` when Account is the address, `in` when Destination is, else `other`

fee_xrp.description: Fee in XRP when the direction is `out`; else null

hash.description: Transaction hash; null when the ledger entry carries none

invoice_id.description: The transaction's `InvoiceID`, 64-hex as the ledger holds it; null when absent

ledger_index.description: Ledger the transaction was validated in; null when the ledger entry names none

partial_payment.description: True for a Payment with flag tfPartialPayment (0x00020000)

result.description: Result code, for example `tesSUCCESS`; null when the ledger entry carries none

source_tag.description: The transaction's `SourceTag`, the sender's tag; null when absent

type.description: Transaction type, for example `Payment`; null when the ledger entry carries none

title: Account transactions
